title: FilmCraft: Free Open-Source Video Editor – Download
excerpt: FilmCraft is a free, open-source video editor for Windows, macOS and Linux. Download it, install in minutes, and follow our step-by-step tutorials.
content_html:
FilmCraft v0.19.0 Alpha — 100% Free & Open Source

FilmCraft — The Free, Open-Source Video Editor Built Like Premiere Pro

Master the timeline you already know. Explore a free, open-source video editor with a familiar Premiere-style timeline on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Creator Starter Kit

Know what to say and what to shoot.

Plan your next YouTube video or Short with fill-in-the-blank scripts, shot prompts, and a publishing checklist.

Preview the 30-second script

Make Speech Clearer Under Music

Record a timeline with a spoken line and background music on separate tracks. Use music you have permission to publish. Example spoken line: “Start with the strongest shot.” Keep playback volume fixed through the comparison.

  1. 0–4s

    Audio · Play “Start with the strongest shot” with music masking part of the line.

    Shot · Play the rough cut and then pause on the timeline.

    On-screen text · Can you hear every word?

  2. 4–10s

    Audio · “The music competes with the voice here.”

    Shot · Solo each track briefly, then return to the full mix.

    On-screen text · Voice + music

  3. 10–22s

    Audio · “Lower the music track a little. Loop the same sentence until every word is clear.”

    Shot · Lower the music track fader in small steps. Play the sentence once while the fader is visible.

    On-screen text · Lower music under speech

  4. 22–30s

    Audio · Play the same line twice, once from each mix, with no narration over it.

    Shot · Use identical footage and switch the label between the two plays.

    On-screen text · Before → After

Core Definition New Software Architecture

What is FilmCraft?

FilmCraft is a free, open-source non-linear video editor written in Rust. The ArtCraft team and contributors maintain the upstream alpha, and its source code is dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The editor uses a Premiere-style timeline. Playback and export depend on the codec, GPU, drivers and effects. Check the upstream release notes and try representative footage before switching a project.

Engineering Specs

Engineered for Precision & Velocity

Explore the editor’s timeline, color and export workflows in the upstream alpha.

view_timeline

Pro Track Timeline

Track targeting, ripple edit (B), rolling edit (N), slip (Y), and slide (U) tools for timeline editing.

palette

Full Color Scopes & LUTs

Real-time Waveform, RGB Parade, Vectorscope, and 3D .CUBE LUT support with 32-bit floating point color pipeline.

subtitles

On-Device Whisper Captions

Generate 99+ language subtitles locally on your GPU without cloud servers. Auto-sync, style, and burn-in directly.

speed

Rust High-Speed Engine

FilmCraft is written in Rust. Responsiveness varies with the build, hardware and project.

keyboard

Premiere-style Hotkeys

FilmCraft uses a Premiere-style shortcut layout. J-K-L shuttle, C razor, V selection, I/O in-out marks operate out of the box.

devices

Cross-Platform Native

The upstream release provides builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. GPU features vary by platform and codec.

Decision Guide

FilmCraft vs Adobe Premiere Pro

Evaluate the architectural differences between an open-source Rust engine and a legacy subscription suite.

Feature Metric FilmCraft v0.19.0 Adobe Premiere Pro
License & Pricing Free download (MIT OR Apache-2.0) Paid subscription
Operating Systems macOS, Windows, Linux macOS & Windows only
Offline Capability See upstream documentation for your release Requires Periodic Cloud Login
Keyboard Muscle Memory Premiere-style key mapping Standard

Knowledge Base

Frequently Asked Questions

Is FilmCraft free to download?

Yes. The upstream FilmCraft editor is free to download and dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Can I import my existing Premiere Pro projects?

Yes. You can export a Final Cut Pro XML (.xml) or EDL from Premiere Pro and import it cleanly into FilmCraft with cuts, audio gain, and tracks preserved.

Does FilmCraft collect any personal data?

Consult the upstream documentation and source for your desktop version. FilmCraft.tech describes its website analytics in its privacy policy.

What are the minimum system requirements?

Check the upstream platform notes and test a representative project on your hardware.
